checks.name: A3 sync 3 of 3 removed, on the erase of the old slot
checks.note: removing it breaks nothing under any cut or survival subset, so it is redundant for correctness -- it still bounds how much work a restart has to redo

checks.name: A3 at least one sync is load-bearing
checks.note: 2 of 3 syncs, when removed, break an invariant under some cut. The others are not doing correctness work, and saying so is the point of the ablation

checks.name: A4 real process killed at each of 6 operations
checks.note: 12 of 12 children died before returning. Real files, real os.write and os.fsync, os._exit at the fault point

checks.name: A4 the real runs match what the simulation predicted
checks.note: the simulated counterpart of a killed process is the cut in which every pending write survives, since the kernel flushes its page cache regardless of what happened to the writer. Agreement is what licenses reading A1-A3, which are simulated, as statements about the algorithm
